Human Prompt: Show me the JNI header files (*.h).
Cypher Query: MATCH (f:File) WHERE f.path ENDS WITH '.h' AND f.code CONTAINS 'JNIEXPORT' RETURN f.path;

Human Prompt: Which Java methods are linked to native functions?
Cypher Query: MATCH (m:Method) WHERE m.signature CONTAINS ' native ' RETURN m.name;

Human Prompt: Get all Groovy classes in the project.
Cypher Query: MATCH (c:Class) WHERE c.file_path ENDS WITH '.groovy' RETURN c.name;

Human Prompt: List all usages of Groovy's 'each' closure.
Cypher Query: MATCH (m:Method) WHERE m.file_path ENDS WITH '.groovy' AND m.code CONTAINS '.each {' RETURN m.name;

Human Prompt: Find all 'Spock' test specifications.
Show me the 'when-then' blocks in Spock tests.
Cypher Query: MATCH (m:Method) WHERE m.code CONTAINS 'when:' AND m.code CONTAINS 'then:' RETURN m.name;

Human Prompt: Which classes use 'GroovyShell' to execute scripts?
Cypher Query: MATCH (m:Method)-[:CALLS]->(callee) WHERE callee.signature CONTAINS 'new GroovyShell' RETURN m.name;

Human Prompt: Get all Scala classes in the project.
Cypher Query: MATCH (c:Class) WHERE c.file_path ENDS WITH '.scala' RETURN c.name;

Human Prompt: List all 'case classes' or 'objects'.
Cypher Query: MATCH (c:Class) WHERE c.file_path ENDS WITH '.scala' AND (c.signature CONTAINS 'case class' OR c.signature CONTAINS 'object ') RETURN c.name;

Human Prompt: Find all usages of 'Future' in Scala.
Cypher Query: MATCH (m:Method) WHERE m.file_path ENDS WITH '.scala' AND m.code CONTAINS 'Future {' RETURN m.name;

Human Prompt: Show me all 'Akka' actors.
Cypher Query: MATCH (c:Class) WHERE c.file_path ENDS WITH '.scala' AND c.extension = 'Actor' RETURN c.name;

Human Prompt: Which classes use 'implicit' definitions?
Cypher Query: MATCH (c:Class) WHERE c.file_path ENDS WITH '.scala' AND c.code CONTAINS 'implicit' RETURN c.name;

Human Prompt: Get all 'build.sbt' files.
List all library dependencies from 'build.sbt'.
Cypher Query: MATCH (f:File {path: 'build.sbt'}) WHERE f.code CONTAINS 'libraryDependencies' RETURN f.code;

Human Prompt: Find all sbt plugins.
Show me the Scala version used.
Cypher Query: MATCH (f:File {path: 'build.sbt'}) WHERE f.code CONTAINS 'scalaVersion' RETURN f.code;

Human Prompt: Which methods use pattern matching?
Cypher Query: MATCH (m:Method) WHERE m.file_path ENDS WITH '.scala' AND m.code CONTAINS ' match {' RETURN m.name;
